description: Read recorded notes, emails, calls, meetings, and tasks in the user's connected HubSpot portal. Use this for follow-ups, explicit next steps, and supporting activity. Select one portal when several are connected. Defaults to a bounded 30-day window; use contact_id to check later activity for a specific person. Cite the returned record URLs. Partial history or missing activity does not establish an unresolved request or an overdue task.

contact_id.description: A HubSpot contact id, to read activity for one person.

days.description: How many days back to read. Defaults to 30.

kind.description: One kind of activity. Omit for all kinds.

limit.description: Most records to return. Defaults to 25.

portal_id.description: The HubSpot portal to read, when several are connected.

name: get_hubspot_activity
title: Read CRM activity
